title: Search for files by name using Spotlight command line
summary: Use the mdfind command to quickly locate files on your Mac by their name. This is useful when you know part of a filename but not its exact location.

aliases.text: как найти файл по имени на маке

steps.explain: Run mdfind with the -name flag followed by the partial or full name of the file you are looking for.

placeholders.name: FILE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name or part of the name of the file you want to find.
